trans.sense: old enough to be considered an adult

examples.text: He's of age now: he can make his own decisions.

glosses: Old enough to be considered an adult (in law, or by society generally).

examples.text: He has a son who is six years of age.
One must be 18 years of age to be an eligible voter in most countries.
Once one is of age 16, one's horizons broaden; once one is of age 21 one's horizons are limitless.

raw_glosses: (formal, idiomatic, law, usually literary) Having existed for a certain period of time; used in referring to a person's age.
